## Probability

::: card-grid
::: project-card
[Student Lecture · July 2025]{.card-kicker}

#### [Martingales and Related Processes](files/Probability_and_Stochastics/martingales_intro_notes.pdf)

Notes for lectures I gave as a student in a graduate stochastic processes course where students delivered the lectures. Covers martingales and their relationships to Markov, Wiener and Poisson processes, with an introduction to stochastic kernels.
:::

::: project-card
[Assignment · Winter 2025]{.card-kicker}

#### [From the CRP to the GEM Distribution](files/NPBayes/NPBayes_hmwk3.pdf)

An assignment for a graduate Bayesian nonparametrics course: a detailed proof that the proportions from the Chinese Restaurant Process converge in distribution to the GEM distribution.
:::

::: project-card
[Assignment · Winter 2025]{.card-kicker}

#### [Size-Biased Permutations of the Poisson–Dirichlet Distribution](files/NPBayes/NPBayes_hmwk4.pdf)

An assignment for a graduate Bayesian nonparametrics course, showing that the size-biased permutation of the two-parameter Poisson–Dirichlet distribution is the two-parameter GEM distribution.
:::
:::

#### [A Comparative Study of Bayesian Factor Models under PLT and UGLT Identification Constraints](https://ssc.ca/en/meeting/annual/presentation/a-comparative-study-bayesian-factor-models-under-positive-lower)

::: project-card
[Talk · April 2025]{.card-kicker}

#### [Sparse Bayesian Factor Analysis when the Number of Factors is Unknown](files/Talks_and_Presentations/SBCA.pdf)

A review of Frühwirth-Schnatter et al. (*Bayesian Analysis*, 2025), covering spike-and-slab priors, shrinkage priors and UGLT structures.
:::

::: project-card
[Talk]{.card-kicker}

#### [Reversible Jump MCMC](files/Talks_and_Presentations/RJMCMC.pdf)

Background on reversible jump MCMC for models where the number of parameters is itself unknown.
:::

::: project-card
[Talk · January 2025]{.card-kicker}

#### [Sparse Principal Component Analysis](files/Talks_and_Presentations/factor_analysis.pdf)

Links between factor analysis and PCA, and a simulation comparison of sparse PCA against varimax rotation.
:::

::: project-card
[Talk · September 2024]{.card-kicker}

#### [Hamiltonian Monte Carlo](files/Talks_and_Presentations/HMC_Presentation.pdf)

A conceptual and mathematical overview of HMC, plus a co-developed Shiny app for sampling with it.

#### [Impacts of Diet Intervention on the Gut Microbiome](files/Data_Science/MicrobiomeGut.pdf)

PCA and model-based clustering of microbiome counts with 1400+ features to compare plant- and animal-based diets.

[Data Science · December 2024]{.card-kicker}

#### [Spatio-Temporal Analysis of Bird Migration](files/Data_Science/bird_dat.pdf)

A spatio-temporal mixed model cut test error from 1,377 to 31 compared with ridge-penalised Poisson regression.
:::

::: project-card
[Data Science · November 2024]{.card-kicker}

#### [Establishing Baseline Climate Partitions via Clustering](files/Data_Science/780As3.pdf)

K-means and agglomerative clustering of Canadian climate rasters, with the number of clusters chosen by silhouette analysis.
:::

[Data Science · September 2024]{.card-kicker}

#### [Expansion of Canadian Agriculture and the Relationship with Wetlands in Boreal Shield Provinces](files/Data_Science/780As1.pdf)
